thread:
Maria - AE: Heads up - Acme asked for our SOC 2 report, a short bridge/ack letter, and temporary access to POC evidence next week. They want a window for review and a custodian contact. cc @Tony for provisioning.
Tony - Solutions Eng: Happy to lead the POC side. Quick Q: will Acme sign NDA before we hand anything over? For temporary access we usually do presigned URLs or an assumed role. How long do they want access for?
Maria - AE: Contact is julia@acme.com. They asked for Mon-Fri next week (Apr 6-10) initially and may request an extra couple of days. NDA status: pending - Lex, can legal expedite?
Lex - Legal: We can expedite an NDA and include a short bridge/ack clause. Send me the customer email and any special terms. We prefer to limit access to 7 days max by default and require that bridge letter explicitly states it's not a SOC2 attestation. I'll send the NDA template to julia now.
Sam - Security: For any access we need: 1) IP allowlist, 2) MFA enforced for any account, 3) audit logging enabled and delivered to our internal SIEM. For short-term access presigned URLs are OK but prefer STS assume-role sessions when downloads are allowed. Also need the custodian (tony+acme@redwood.com) to be the point of contact. :lock: 
Tony - Solutions Eng: I can be custodian. If legal is OK, I'll create a read-only role and provide either presigned links or session creds. Maria - confirm they want download permission or view-only.
Maria - AE: Julia confirmed they need to download a subset of evidence for their security team. They asked whether we can extend two extra days if needed.
Lex - Legal: NDA sent to julia@acme.com; I added clause: "temporary access to specified evidence under NDA; bridge letter provided on receipt of signed NDA; access limited to specified bucket and time window." Once NDA returns signed, Lex will sign off on bridge letter text.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created temp object s3://redwood-poc/acme-evidence/manifest.txt (metadata-only).
Tony - Solutions Eng: Provisioning plan: create role redwood-acme-reviewer (ReadOnly), session duration 12h, attach policy restricting to prefix acme-evidence/*. I will provide step-by-step doc and either presigned link generator or temporary credentials. Sample policy snippet:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],
  "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-poc","arn:aws:s3:::redwood-poc/acme-evidence/*"]
}
```
Sam - Security: Approved with conditions: baseline scan completed, session audit enabled, session duration capped at 12h per day, overall access window capped at 7 days (can request extension with justification), and IP allowlist must include Acme corporate IPs. We'll capture CloudTrail and hand over logs slice.
Maria - AE: Julia replied that NDA was signed this morning and asked if bridge letter can be emailed and if we can extend to Apr 12 if needed. She also requested a named contact for downloads.
Tony - Solutions Eng: I created temporary role and STS link. I tested download with read-only policy. Sending custodian contact: tony+acme@redwood.com. Also sending the mini runbook: steps to assume role and sample aws cli commands.
Tony - Solutions Eng: Runbook excerpt:
```
# assume role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-acme-reviewer --role-session-name acmeReview
# download object
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-poc/acme-evidence/example.pdf ./example.pdf
```
Lex - Legal: Bridge letter draft below - please do not forward until I sign it (internal approval step completed):
"Redwood Inference will provide limited, temporary access to selected SOC 2 evidence to Acme Corporation under the terms of the executed NDA. This access is provided for evaluation purposes only and does not constitute a SOC 2 attestation. Access will be limited to specified S3 prefixes and will be time-bound as agreed between parties."
Sam - Security: I'll attach monitoring: CloudTrail slice + S3 object-level access logs copied to our retention bucket. Alerts if objects downloaded > 250 MB or more than 100 files in an hour.
Maria - AE: Sending bridge letter + provisioned access now. Will confirm once customer acknowledges. :rocket: 
Tony - Solutions Eng: Sent email to julia@acme.com with bridge letter, custodian contact, STS instructions, and the first 12h session link. Included note: "If you need an extension please request via this thread and provide reason and list of reviewers."
Maria - AE: Julia acknowledged receipt and asked for extension to Apr 12 and redaction guidance. I'll escalate to Lex & Sam for final say.
Lex - Legal: Extension to Apr 12 OK in principle but require written justification from Acme security lead and a sign-off that data will not be redistributed. I'll prepare an addendum to the bridge letter.
Sam - Security: Extension approved conditionally - require Acme IPs, reviewer email list, and we'll keep heightened monitoring. I'll provision a second 12h session on Apr 11 if needed.
Maria - AE: Great - I'll collect the reviewer names and IPs and post here. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup: 
Tony - Solutions Eng: Noting action items: (1) Provide session links when requested, (2) share runbook, (3) monitor downloads and report. Leaving a brief note in the POC ticket.
Maria - AE: Closing loop - customer confirmed extension to Apr 12 and sent reviewer list. Bridge letter signed. I'll update the deal thread.
Tony - Solutions Eng: All done from infra side. If anything unexpected shows up ping me directly.
Sam - Security: I'll package the audit slice and keep retention log. Marking security tasks completed for this window.
Maria - AE: Thanks team - excellent coordination.
